title: Quentin and the Glasshouse
author: U. M. Fairweather
blurb: Ines Sandoval, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
